settings.heading: Desert Rose
settings.body: A warm Dubai evening, bottled. Velvety Bulgarian rose and Damask rose petal settle into smoky oud and rosewood, lifted by a bright finish of bergamot and berry. Rich, feminine and made to linger on skin and fabric alike.
settings.notes: Bulgarian Rose, Damask Rose Petal, Oud, Rosewood, Bergamot, Berry

settings.heading: Silk Oasis
settings.body: Soft as silk and calm as an oasis at dusk. Smooth oud wood and Rose de Mai open into a garden of jasmine, peony and amaryllis blossom over warm rosewood. Light enough for every day, elegant enough for every occasion.
settings.notes: Oud Wood, Rose de Mai, Jasmine, Peony, Rosewood, Amaryllis Blossom

settings.heading: Laya Beauty
settings.intro: Fragrance mists and body lotions inspired by the gardens and evenings of Dubai, made to layer and to last.
settings.note: Launch offer: any two mists or lotions for $30, applied automatically at checkout.
settings.step_1_text: Smooth the body lotion over clean, slightly damp skin after your shower.
settings.step_2_text: Mist from arm's length over skin, hair and hijab while the lotion is still fresh.
settings.step_3_text: Keep the mist close and add a light veil whenever you want the scent to bloom again.
